title: The Rabbit Artist
text: In the morning, the Apprentice and the Keeper came to a busy garden. A rabbit in a helmet stood by a pumpkin. The rabbit was an artist, and the rabbit was busy. "Pardon me," said the rabbit. "Start at the barn. A torn page is in the basket."

title: The Picnic Fork
text: On a stormy morning, the Apprentice and the Keeper came to a picnic. The Keeper packed a sandwich, a muffin, a napkin and a fork. A rabbit in a helmet came for the muffin! The rabbit took the fork and the napkin. "Pardon me," said the Keeper. "That fork is for the garden party!"

title: The Bird on the Perch
text: After dinner, the Apprentice and the Keeper came to a church corner. A bird was swirling, twirling and chirping over a silver perch. "Do not disturb the bird," said the Keeper. "Be a perfect helper." The Apprentice stood under the perch. The bird dropped a letter. It was dirty, but it was perfect.

title: The Herd of Sheep
text: After supper, the Apprentice and the Keeper saw a herd of thirty sheep. One sheep was eating a paper letter. "Disturb the herd," said the Keeper. The Apprentice gave a super yawn, like thunder. The herd was turning, and the sheep dropped the letter. The letter was a dirty, perfect page.

title: The Tool List
text: A carpenter was sharpening a saw by a hilltop hut. Yesterday, a thunderstorm broke the shelter. "I need a perfect shelter," said the carpenter. The Apprentice was looking at the list: hammer, ladder, paper, rope. The Keeper was confirming it. Then the Apprentice and the Keeper picked up a hammer and a ladder. The carpenter grinned and said, "Start!"

title: The Thunderstorm
text: A thunderstorm was darkening the hilltop. Thundering clouds were over the shelter. The Apprentice, the Keeper and the carpenter were in the shelter. "Is it perfectly safe?" said the Apprentice. "Yes," said the carpenter. The thundering stopped, and a perfect page was in the garden.
